title: Large Surface Area Ordered Porous Carbons via Nanocasting Zeolite 10X and High Performance for Hydrogen Storage Application
material_description: 10Xc-60 | zeolite-10X-templated carbon from the liquid-gas two-step route: furfuryl alcohol impregnated into 10X zeolite and heated at 80 C for 24 h and 150 C for 8 h in N2, then acetylene CVD (N2/C2H2 95:5, 100 mL/min, 4 h) at 600 C; 10X zeolite template (SiO2/Al2O3 = 2.6-3.0, Jianlong Chem. Co., precalcined 550 C 6 h); zeolite-carbon composite heated at 900 C for 3 h; template removed by refluxing in concentrated HCl at 60 C for 3.5 h then washing with 40% HF at room temperature for 6 h; dried at 120 C
functional_groups: oxygen-containing groups (O content by difference; authors attribute it mainly to the etching step)
source_location: main article p.171 (main-5.png), Table 1, row 10Xc-60, H2 1 bar column; same measurement as the 1-bar point of Figure 5 (p.172, main-6.png) series 10Xc-60
notes: digitized: not separable (the 1-bar marker overlaps the other 0-1 bar markers of all four series), archive: fig5_10Xc-60.json; Table 1 summarizes the Figure 5 isotherm capacities at 1 and 20 bar (text p.172); isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 15 markers counted at 2-20 bar plus the 1-bar point reported in Table 1; the 0-1 bar markers of this series are hidden behind the other series and could not be counted; basis: the paper calls its buoyancy-corrected values "absolute" (SI p.S7) without defining the basis; its correction volume is skeletal volume (1.5 g/cm3) plus the N2 total pore volume, i.e. corrected density 1/(1/1.5 + V_total); basis_stated coded false (named, not defined), basis_inferred = absolute by the name rule; replicates_reported true: two distinct 77 K H2 isotherms of 10Xc-60 over 0-1 bar are reported (Figure 5 inset and Figure S5a, with different pressure points); S_DFT 2144 m2/g (DFT); micropore area 1535 m2/g from t-plot (carbon black STPA, 0.45-0.6 nm film thickness); V_total from N2 at P/P0 = 0.995, V_micro from t-plot; pore sizes printed 6/8/12/20 A (NLDFT PSD on N2, slit pores); average_pore_diameter_nm = 1.2 nm from the printed 12 A peak, the major micropore size of all carbons per text p.171; elemental analysis (temperature-programmed oxidation; O by difference): C 87.11%, H 0.92%, O 11.97%; BET range: P/P0 = 0.02-0.25; BET fits stated with R > 0.999 and positive C (SI S3) but no consistency criteria stated as applied; H2 degassing printed as 10^-6 bar at 200 C for 3 h (heating 1 C/min), stored as 0.1 Pa; skeletal density 1.5 g/cm3 is the value the authors used for buoyancy correction (not stated as measured)

measuring_lab_id: Zhao group, Qingdao Institute of Bioenergy and Bioprocess Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

Co., precalcined 550 C 6 h); zeolite-carbon composite heated at 900 C for 3 h; template removed by refluxing in concentrated HCl at 60 C for 3.5 h then washing with 40% HF at room temperature for 6 h; dried at 120 C
functional_groups: oxygen-containing groups (O content by difference; authors attribute it mainly to the etching step)
source_location: SI p.S7 (si1-7.png), Figure S6, series 0.17 g/cm3 (black filled squares), 10Xc-70
notes: archive: figS6_10Xc-70_rho0.17.json; basis: no basis named for the 0.17 g/cm3 correction; it uses a corrected density below the skeletal density, so the buoyancy-correction default (excess) does not apply; basis_inferred coded unknown (conservative); same raw 10Xc-70 measurement as Figure 5 (I4) re-corrected with density 0.17 g/cm3 (the paper reports 0.383 g/cm3 values); separate isotherm_id because the values differ; isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 19 markers at 2-20 bar plus a partly visible marker near 1 bar; 0-1 bar markers hidden; S_DFT 3340 m2/g (DFT); micropore area 2281 m2/g from t-plot (carbon black STPA, 0.45-0.6 nm film thickness); V_total from N2 at P/P0 = 0.995, V_micro from t-plot; pore sizes printed 6/8/12/20 A (NLDFT PSD on N2, slit pores); average_pore_diameter_nm = 1.2 nm from the printed 12 A peak, the major micropore size of all carbons per text p.171; elemental analysis (temperature-programmed oxidation; O by difference): C 89.16%, H 1.83%, O 9.01%; BET range: P/P0 = 0.02-0.25; BET fits stated with R > 0.999 and positive C (SI S3) but no consistency criteria stated as applied; H2 degassing printed as 10^-6 bar at 200 C for 3 h (heating 1 C/min), stored as 0.1 Pa; skeletal density 1.5 g/cm3 is the value the authors used for buoyancy correction (not stated as measured)

measuring_lab_id: Zhao group, Qingdao Institute of Bioenergy and Bioprocess Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
